title: Research: four-role mixed D8 target has exact five-call minimum
body:
## Result

This adds an exact minimum for one four-role heterogeneous target in the formal group algebra `F2[D8]`, where `D8=<a,b | a^2=b^2=e,(ab)^4=e>` has order eight. Paid factors are `I+([g]+[e])N` for `g in {a,b}` and every binary rank-one idempotent `N` in `M4(F2)`. The target is `diag([a],[ab],[ba],[e])`.

The exact minimum is five. The package gives the direct word
`D_(a,E00) D_(a,E11) D_(b,E11) D_(b,E22) D_(a,E22)` and excludes every word of length at most four by exact coefficient arithmetic over all of `F2[D8]`.

## Verification

The replay enumerates all 120 idempotents and 240 paid factors, forms all 57,600 ordered pair products (32,651 distinct states), and checks the target-specific length 0–4 meetings. Matrix entries retain all eight group coefficients. It also checks the positive five-factor word and seven negative controls.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/d8-mixed-target-seeda97c8e
```

Local result: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`; `git diff --check` passes. Package metadata and exact base pins pass. The selected-result baseline orientation script was attempted but cannot complete in this sparse worktree because its selected certificate package inventory is not materialized; that limitation does not affect the D8 certificate.

## Scope and attribution

This result extends the D8 line of PR #1742 (head `679f3624a0a41ed14942825dd7f413132412d1e3`), which establishes an eight-call minimum for a three-role duplicated central-commutator target and leaves four-role models open. This contribution changes the role count and target to a reflection, both orientations of an order-four rotation, and one identity role. The initial S3/`GL2(F2)` candidate was dropped because PR #1763 (head `07910c7bee862dadbb3b3d30ea5dfcdbbbe23fda`) uses the same four-role alphabet and pair-state method for repeated order-three targets. No predecessor executable is imported.

Cycle seed `a97c8efa02e2955139574300f12b9c03`, track `bit-mechanisms`, task `bit-new-register-model`, priority revision 3. Exact base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

The fourth role is restored on arbitrary inputs. The full finite model is counted, but no source-word mapping, supplier adoption, paid-moment change, or kappa improvement is claimed. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review is claimed.
